abstracted_predicate.name: PRESERVES_VERIFIED_SUBSTANCE_DURING_REPRESENTATIONAL_REVISION
abstracted_predicate.definition: The action revises an artifact's incidental representational form while reproducing substantive content that the reasoning has already established as verified or correct, without recomputing, adding, or removing substantive values.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text establishing that the artifact's substantive content is already verified or correct and that only an incidental representational property requires correction.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The artifact revision that changes the incidental representational property while preserving the already-verified substantive content.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning establishes that the substantive content or values of the artifact have already been verified or are correct, and that only an incidental representational property needs correction.

The action revises the artifact's representational form, reproducing the same substantive content while changing an incidental representational property such as formatting, encoding, layout, or presentation.
The action does not recompute, add, or remove any substantive value.
exclusion_conditions: The action changes substantive values, or adds or removes data.
The reasoning does not establish the content as already verified or correct before the revision.
The action's purpose is to correct substantive content rather than only an incidental representational property.
